Samira (CSM): Heads-up: Argent Labs onboarding checkpoint. Need to close networking, KMS grants, and audit export before we hand off to ops tomorrow. Looping in infra and security. @Marta @Riley @Priya @Omar
Omar (SolutionsEng): I went through their VPC layout. Network constraint: they disallow peering. That rules out cross-account peering; PrivateLink or transit gateway? PrivateLink looks like the least friction for us. Also need to know whether they want a CMK in their account or cross-account grants from our CMK.
Marta (Argent Labs): Confirmed: security will not approve VPC peering. We'll proceed with Interface Endpoints (PrivateLink). For keys, we prefer to own CMK; we'll give Redwood the necessary grants. Audit logs must land in our S3 bucket with lifecycle 1 year and partitioning for Athena.
Riley (Network): Good. We'll request interface endpoints in three AZs. Need these details from Argent: subnet IDs (one per AZ), associated route tables, and whether NAT is used for egress. Firewall/proxy note: their proxy blocks direct egress, they'll need to whitelist our domains.
Marta (Argent Labs): Yes, our proxy blocks direct egress. I'll open a ticket to whitelist endpoints: api.redwood-inference.com:443, sts.amazonaws.com, and s3.amazonaws.com. Expect approval in ~24h.
Priya (Security): For KMS, provide the exact role ARN Redwood will use. Minimal policy we need:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Sid": "Admins", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root"}, "Action": "kms:*", "Resource": "*" },
    { "Sid": "RedwoodGrant", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::789012345678:role/redwood-service"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```

Enable automatic rotation. We'll sign off once we have the role ARN and policy applied.
Omar (SolutionsEng): For CloudTrail delivery: either Argent runs the create-trail steps or we can provide Terraform for them. Quick CLI sample for their reference:

```
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name argent-redwood-trail --s3-bucket-name argent-onboard-logs
aws cloudtrail put-event-selectors --trail-name argent-redwood-trail --event-selectors '[{"ReadWriteType":"All","IncludeManagementEvents":true}]'
aws cloudtrail start-logging --name argent-redwood-trail
```

Also create a grant for KMS:

```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/argent-cmk --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::789012345678:role/redwood-service --operations "Encrypt" "Decrypt" "GenerateDataKey"
```

Replace ARNs as needed.
deploy-bot: infra-scan: VPC OK, NAT present, interface endpoints not found, KMS alias "alias/argent-cmk" missing, S3 bucket argent-onboard-logs exists but no CloudTrail objects detected.
Marta (Argent Labs): We'll create the CMK today and run the CloudTrail create once the proxy is whitelisted. Can you confirm Redwood's role ARN so we can include it in the key policy?
Omar (SolutionsEng): Redwood role ARN: arn:aws:iam::789012345678:role/redwood-service. I'll publish the endpoint service name when infra finishes provisioning: com.amazonaws.vpce.us-west-2.vpce-svc-0abc123def456 (tx to eng-runtime for confirmation).
Priya (Security): Contract/Renewal note: Legal marked this account as needing audit logs available before renewal. Renewal due in ~3 weeks. If CloudTrail and KMS access aren't validated before renewal, this is a medium-high risk. Recommend prioritizing audit log delivery and an evidence packet for Legal.
Samira (CSM): Understood. I'll escalate with Sales/Legal and mark the account "at risk" in the tracker. Scheduling a handoff/workshop: Thursday 9am PT. Invite sent to Omar, Riley, Priya, Marta, and Argent infra. Agenda: finalize PrivateLink setup, confirm KMS policy, run a smoke test for CloudTrail -> S3 -> Redwood validation, sign-off checklist.
Omar (SolutionsEng): My action items: publish endpoint service ARN, share the role ARN (done), run a smoke run to validate CloudTrail objects and KMS decrypt flow. ETA: tomorrow morning.
Riley (Network): Argent infra action: provide subnet IDs for 3 AZs, confirm proxy whitelist, and share route table IDs. ETA: 24h per Marta.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare the SOC2 evidence checklist and the minimal security sign-off doc. Need to verify S3 bucket encryption uses the CMK and that CloudTrail log file validation is enabled.
Samira (CSM): I'll keep the onboarding tracker updated and will post the smoke test results here. Next check-in by 1763504800. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
